name: Tsuukin Kairaku 3 ~Chikan yo, Tomare~
original_name: 通勤快楽3～痴漢よ、止まれ～
source:
Jinnosuke is a president of a big company. He is respected by a lot of people, but he likes to do train molestation...

His company actually sells various items for repelling molesters. To do research or look for good ideas for new items, he everyday gets on the train with his beautiful secretary and enjoys train molestation. In the crowded train, his lewd hands grope the bodies of his target women...
